integrity: Analytical proof supplied; standard-library exact-rational script provides finite diagnostics only; mathematical correctness and priority have not been independently assessed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed known dimension d>=2, strictly positive sign-symmetric nearest-neighbor axis weights summing to one, exact even-time return probabilities; recovery only up to axis permutation; generic minimality away from repeated weights; no noise stability, unknown-support inference or general symmetric finite-range extension.
title: Sharp finite-return tomography for anisotropic nearest-neighbor lattice walks
